detail.Why it matters: opening bets predict near-term moves, but the edge lives in EXTREME one-sided flow — a near-even lean is a coin flip. Even the best academic flow signals are worth ~0.4-1% over days, which is why every other gate must also hold

elements.label: Where's the money betting?
elements.logic: side with more opening premium wins; needs 2:1 dominance and $500K+ to count as qualified, else it caps the call at Mixed

elements.label: Does the live tape agree?
elements.logic: sign of the session net delta

elements.label: Is the bet being held?
elements.logic: growth in OI at the bet's strikes

elements.label: Will moves extend or fade?
elements.logic: negative dealer gamma extends moves, positive pins them

elements.label: Which way is fear priced?
elements.logic: risk-reversal change vs its own normal (oppose caps the verdict)
elements.meaning: no baseline yet — needs 3+ prior sessions of risk-reversal history, so this name can't reach Favorable today

detail.The call: no chain to price the trade
detail.Why it matters: the costs are certain, the move isn't: a wide spread can eat 10%+ round trip and a weekly bleeds theta every day — that's why cost alone can kill an otherwise good setup

elements.label: Is it worth the cost?
elements.logic: PASS on event, earnings, or spread bigger than the move
elements.meaning: no chain to price the trade

elements.label: Which contract?
elements.logic: flow side, 2-14 days out, strike nearest the price

next_step: Nothing compelling. Doing nothing is the default. If you trade anyway it's your judgment over the data: the contract tile shows what you'd buy.

regime.label: What's the market backdrop?
regime.logic: same for every ticker. a macro event inside 5d flags Cost (caution), only earnings block
regime.meaning: SPY gamma n/a · IV n/a · tide n/a

reasons: cost: no chain to price the trade

verdict_logic: Stand down if cost says PASS or there's no flow to read. Favorable needs a qualified opening-flow lean (2:1 and $500K+), OI not shrinking, trend gamma, readable skew, no skew/tape conflict, cost fully clean. Anything else is Mixed — and 'disagree' Mixed (something contradicts the bet) is closer to Stand down than 'weak' Mixed (something fell short).
